text:
samir: Hey all — first day! Setting up observability for private-llm. I can view Datadog dashboards but get a 403 when creating monitors, Grafana panels show but alerting is greyed out, and the Sentry DSN for the private cluster is missing from secrets. Who owns the perms/provisioning?

devops-bot: Welcome @samir! Quick checklist: 1) join `eng-observability` group 2) request Grafana folder Editor+Alerting 3) open an infra ticket with Sentry slug + repo. Docs: https://redwood.internal/obs/onboard :wave:

jess: Hi @samir — Datadog 403 usually means missing `monitors_write` or no app key. Paste the Datadog dashboard URL and I can verify. If you want I can create a short-lived test monitor tagged `team:private-llm` to validate routing.

lina: Grafana alerting being greyed out is typically folder-level perms. Grab the dashboard UID: Dashboards -> Share -> Link (uid=XXXX) and paste it. If the tooltip on the button says "insufficient permissions" I can add Editor+Alerting for you. If it says "feature disabled" we need an infra toggle.

samir: Datadog URL: https://datadog.redwood.internal/dash/klmn-9876/private-llm?from_ts=1620000000000&to_ts=1620003600000

jess: Thanks — I see you don't have `monitors_write`. I can create this monitor for you. Example (replace keys):
```
curl -s -X POST "https://api.datadoghq.com/api/v1/monitor" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -H \"DD-API-KEY: $DD_API_KEY\" \
  -H \"DD-APPLICATION-KEY: $DD_APP_KEY\" \
  -d '{"name":"test: private-llm latency","type":"metric alert","query":"avg(last_5m):avg:private.requests.latency{env:prod} > 500","message":"@pagerduty test","tags":["team:private-llm"]}'
```
I will tag it `team:private-llm` so routing picks up.

lina: For Sentry please open an infra ticket with: org email domain, desired slug (e.g., `private-llm-samir`), repo/service name, and envs. Infra returns a server DSN (and public DSN if allowed) and updates the secret store and deploy mapping. Use template `obs-onboard` to speed this up.

samir: Filed OBS-2765 with slug `private-llm-samir`, linked the Datadog dashboard and the Grafana UID (uid=R8t4Yz). Thanks — please go ahead with the test monitor.

jess: Created the monitor and fired a test alert. It was routed to #private-llm-alerts. If you don't see it, confirm channel subscription or permissions.

samir: Confirmed I saw the ping in #private-llm-alerts. Lina — thanks for adding Editor+Alerting to the Grafana folder earlier, alerts tab is now visible. I'll follow up with a Grafana panel link for a Confluence embed. :tada:
